name: Gate
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

You conjure a portal within medium range to any other location, which can be a place you can see, a place you can visualize, or one you can describe by stating distance and direction. The portal is circular and of a diameter you choose between 5 and 20 ft. You can see through the portal to the other linked location from either side. Roll Lore to determine any additional effects.

A creature that passes through the portal is immediately transported to the other linked location.
successes:
✨: You may sustain the portal for 1 additional minute.

🌞: You may choose to make the portal persist until dispelled.

💀: The portal's surface is a confusion of swirling energy and its destination is uncertain. Check a Condition. Each time a creature passes through the portal, roll a d8. On a 1, the creature is transported to the place of your birth.
